minutes.headline: Committee named the athletic field and track after two individuals and set a June 25 session on the superintendent contract.
minutes.summary: The meeting covered end-of-year recognitions, policy readings, and a proposal to name the athletic field and track. The business administrator presented final line-item personnel changes and recommended lifting the hiring freeze. The committee also took up high school handbook and improvement plan updates, fall sports waivers, a leave agreement with the educators association, and scheduling a Monday meeting on the superintendent contract.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to name the athletic field and track after two individuals and to approve signage; the vote tally was not audible.
The business administrator said the total budget had not changed and that money was moved between lines, including a new line for webmaster stipends.
The superintendent recommended lifting the hiring freeze, saying the risk to title funding had been accommodated.
The committee approved high school handbook updates, accepted the improvement plan skeleton with the full plan due in January, and approved fall sports waivers.
The committee ratified a leave agreement with the educators association and set a Monday the 25th meeting to go into executive session on the superintendent contract.

why_it_matters: The line shifts and the proposed lifting of the hiring freeze affect school staffing and spending within a budget stated to be unchanged in total, and the new webmaster stipends tie to the educators association contract.
The superintendent contract is being taken up in executive session, so residents will see the outcome only if a public vote follows.
